name: day-trader-skill-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, India edition (NSE/BSE)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Thirteen Claude skills for NSE/BSE: market rules and charges, a chart scanner, a filings and news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine and backtester with Indian costs, an F&O desk, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order executor with a paper broker (never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst and an insider and bulk-deal tracker.
